name_reason: Compliant data_fd2_<domain>_<descriptor> name. Domain chapter_intro, descriptor menu_overlay matches purpose (FDOTHER.DAT[10] menu overlay panel sprite), and _buf_ptr reflects the data type (heap buffer pointer). No Ghidra address residue; all name tokens are semantic. Confirmed by 4 xrefs (2 writers in fd2_chapter_transition_menu, 2 readers in fd2_chapter_transition_menu free + fd2_render_chapter_intro_overlay blit).
purpose: Heap pointer to the chapter-intro menu overlay sprite buffer (FDOTHER.DAT entry 10), composited over the chapter intro RLE backdrop by the radio-button intro menu.
logic_summary: BSS pointer (0-init). In the story-chapter branch of fd2_chapter_transition_menu it is set NULL then assigned fd2_load_dat_resource("FDOTHER.DAT", 10); fd2_render_chapter_intro_overlay passes it to fd2_dialog_sprite_blit_normal(dst, buf, 0x1c8) as the panel sprite source each render frame; freed when the intro menu loop ends (free at 0x2cf4a). Only exercised on story chapters (per_chapter_category[current_chapter]==0); battle chapters never touch it.
datatype: void * (heap buffer pointer); stored in a uint32 slot in src to match the dword load/store at the use sites. Ghidra type is undefined4 (4-byte), decompiler renders it as undefined4 *.
element_semantics: Single scalar pointer: address of the malloc'd FDOTHER.DAT[10] menu-overlay sprite buffer, or NULL when no intro panel is active.
comment_original_issue: src comment (chtrans.c lines 654-666) was already accurate and precise; no issue. Ghidra side: PLATE_COMMENT was blank and the documentation lived in PRE_COMMENT, which violates the project data-plate convention (data plates must use PLATE_COMMENT, not PRE_COMMENT).
notes: src comment kept as-is (correct). Ghidra PLATE_COMMENT created from the accurate PRE_COMMENT content (em-dash -> '--' for ASCII) and the misplaced PRE_COMMENT cleared, conforming to project_ghidra_data_plate_mechanism. No src/field/chtrans.c edit was needed, so only the shard is committed.
